body: What do you want me to do about it?
I think it has to be fixed to run before the skin tool.

SkinTool sets `skin->skeleton` which this function depends on, so it can't run before.

Anyway, I did think of a better solution, ~~but it conflicts with https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/104184, so it would have to wait until after that is merged.~~ In the meantime this PR fixes the specific case of skinned meshes targeted by animation pointers.

EDIT: Wait, it doesn't conflict. It actually works for both cases. I've updated the PR. You may still think the code is ugly, but I think this is necessary...
